title: Dels Quatre Vents
identity: The saxophone publication *Dels Quatre Vents* (UME21470) is an alto saxophone and piano adaptation of the fifth movement in Eduard Toldrà’s *Sis Sonets*, originally written for violin and piano in 1921. A library catalog search result attributes a transcription under this title to José Amaz; exact relation of this edition to other transcriptions needs confirmation.

evidence.claim: UME21470 is listed for alto saxophone and piano.
Toldrà specialist catalog identifies the source cycle as six violin-and-piano sonnets and says there are adaptations for saxophone among other instruments.

Spanish performing-arts library record attributes a transcription of Dels quatre vents to José Amaz and describes the source as a printed violin-and-piano sonnet. It lists a different UME plate number, so its relationship to UME21470 is unresolved.

review_focus: Inference: confirm whether the saxophone part preserves violin-specific phrasing and range in the published sax transcription; no saxophone score was inspected.
collection_flag: Documented transcription of an original violin-and-piano movement. The exact arranger for UME21470 remains uncertain.
gaps: No readable saxophone score or saxophone recording found; musical details and exact adaptation cannot be assessed.
UME21470 and the institutional catalog’s UME21466 record appear to be different publication records; verify edition relationship.
